long_biography.plain_text:
An auctioneer and fellow of the National Association of Valuers and Auctioneers, Morgan developed particular expertise in aviation assets and contentious insolvency assignments. SIA grew from a Brighton auction operation into a national valuation and disposal practice. Its advisers assessed machinery, stock, property and other assets for lenders and restructuring professionals.

EODEX presents a different operating challenge. As chief executive, Morgan oversees a business that investigates and clears unexploded ordnance, boulders and debris from the seabed before offshore projects proceed. Its low-order disposal methods are intended to reduce disturbance to marine life. He remains a director of the EODEX group and its specialist UK companies.
